mapper.select: SELECT hj.CORP_GR AS corpGr , hj.FUND_CD AS fundCd , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , hj.JM_CD AS jmCd , hj.CD_JIGUB_GB AS cdJigubGb , hj.AEKM AS aekm , TO_CHAR(hj.BALH_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS balhYmd , hj.CASH_CD AS cashCd , hj.CHUI_AEK AS chuiAek , hj.HJ_NM AS hjNm , TO_CHAR(hj.MEIB_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS meibYmd , hj.PYOM_IYUL AS pyomIyul , TO_CHAR(hj.AF_IJA_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS afIjaYmd , hj.BOJNG_GB AS bojngGb , hj.NOW_IJA_HOICHA AS nowIjaHoicha , hj.SANGHW_AEK AS sanghwAek , TO_CHAR(hj.SANGHW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghwYmd , hj.SUNHU_GB AS sunhuGb , hj.YY_IJA_HOICHA AS yyIjaHoicha , hj.IJA_YY_SU AS ijaYySu , hj.MEIB_MK_GB AS meibMkGb , hj.MEIB_SUIK_RT AS meibSuikRt , hj.TOT_IJA_GUGAN AS totIjaGugan , hj.OFFER_CO_CD AS offerCoCd , hj.GIUP_GYUMO AS giupGyumo , hj.TR_AEK AS trAek , hj.SUNHU_TAX_GB AS sunhuTaxGb , hj.TAX_OFFER_GB AS taxOfferGb , hj.DAEYEO_GB AS daeyeoGb , hj.BROKER_CD AS brokerCd , hj.SUSU_GA AS susuGa , hj.MEIB_SUIK_RT * 100 AS meibSuikRtPer , hj.PYOM_IYUL * 100 AS pyomIyulPer , hj.BOJNG_CO AS bojngCo , mb.TR_CO_NM AS trCoNm , hj.SUNG_COST AS sungCost , TO_CHAR(hj.OP_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS opYmd , hj.KSD_JM_CD AS ksdJmCd , hj.SEQ_NO AS seqNo , hj.SUSU_09900 AS susu09900 , hj.KSD_JM5 AS ksdJm5 , hj.KSD_JM8 AS ksdJm8 , hj.PG_CD AS pgCd , CASE WHEN hj.BALH_YMD >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pVisible FROM SHM0HJ hj LEFT OUTER JOIN szx2mm mb ON mb.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND mb.TR_CO_CD = hj.BOJNG_CO , SZM0IA ia WHERE hj.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND hj.SANGHW_YMD >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND hj.CASH_CD LIKE #{cashCd} AND hj.CASH_CD <> '90' AND ia.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ia.FUND_CD = hj.FUND_CD AND NVL(ia.HAEJI_YMD, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY hj.CASH_CD , hj.FUND_CD , hj.JM_CD
{ CALL KFP.SR_SHJ0IG(#{corpGr, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jmCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pDel, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) }
